name: Igwe Ebi Mary
title: Software Developer, Digital Creative, and Writer
bio:
Igwe Ebi Mary is a Nigerian Computer Science graduate, software developer, digital creative, and writer with interests spanning technology, design, and digital entrepreneurship. She has a B.Sc. in Computer Science and has pursued additional software engineering training through ALX.

Her areas of interest include web development, e-commerce solutions, website management, graphic and logo design, promotional materials, AI video creation, video editing, and book and content writing. She has been developing projects such as Marygold Collections, an e-commerce initiative, and a personal digital portfolio to showcase her work.

Mary is passionate about using technology and creativity to solve problems, support businesses, and bring ideas to life. She is committed to continuous learning, professional growth, and building a strong digital presence while pursuing freelance opportunities and collaborations with clients locally and internationally.
